The E2E fixture configured only structured_generation, so Runtime goal embeddings failed closed with MODEL_STAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED and cascaded across Task preparation. interpretation: Both failures are deterministic test-composition gaps. Production operation-aware routing and fail-closed MCP authority remain unchanged.
